limits: Exact native crabB / enCrabWizard / renderer 121411 source assignment only; no sibling route or topology receives credit.
The ordinary no-focus hit reduced the same target from 58 HP to 56 HP; death used the separate explicit KillSingle fixture at 56 HP and is not ordinary lethal-damage evidence.
Twenty-one selected original PNGs were reviewed; the remaining 339 retained capture frames and generated videos are preserved evidence but were not individually reviewed.

The fixture death completed all 120 requested frames through Crab_DeathDirect with m_DoRagdoll=false; this is animated death evidence, not ragdoll proof, and no corpse lifetime beyond the sampled window is claimed.

The exact renderer stayed active, enabled and visible in all 360 retained frames; native hat, combat UI, effects, foreground hero, loot overlay, depth blur and camera motion still limit fine inspection.
One native Collect reached strict Ready at level 0 room 2; broader campaign progression was not exercised.
Other proficiencies, Crab_DeathInDirect, portraits, collision, extended culling, long-session resource lifetime and final art-direction approval remain outside this archive.
